warnings: op1 direct read (house 08). Pattern 'misc' — matches spec §1's own pattern #13 example verbatim ('a back-cover price-comparison table across all 10 designs in the series'). See หน้า60's warning: this page was originally guessed to be part of the หลักเกณฑ์ notes block by the Stage-0 manifest; it is not.

SIZE ANOMALY FLAGGED, NOT SILENTLY RESOLVED: this table lists THIS HOUSE (แบบ 6) at 70 ตร.ม. — identical to design 1's size — which does not visually match this house's own floor plan (หน้า06, a roughly 7.6m x 11m footprint spanning multiple rooms) as closely as a much larger size would; however this is the printed source value and is recorded as-is rather than corrected against my own visual floor-area estimate, per the no-guessing rule. A human review with the actual measured floor area would resolve this.

Numbers printed in Thai numerals (๐-๙) — transcribed to Arabic numerals for the JSON quantity fields; flagged for zoom-review since a few digits (particularly in the higher-value prices) were read at only moderate confidence.
